_comment: Claude Code MCP configuration — capability broker architecture
Credential-bearing MCPs reach upstream APIs through the L9 capability broker.
The broker holds secrets; this surface holds only capability IDs.
NO CREDENTIALS in this file or in environment.env — the broker authenticates
this session with the platform-issued workload JWT (CLAUDE_SESSION_JWT).
Graphiti memory is brokered too (capability graphiti.query). This template
carries NO bearer: GRAPHITI_MCP_TOKEN is prohibited in a model-controlled
surface (contract S3/§12). The URL points at the broker front door
(L9_CAPABILITY_BROKER_URL), which resolves the Graphiti credential on its
When the broker URL is unset this server does not resolve and memory runs
DEGRADED — the honest posture, not a reason to paste a token back in.
Set L9_CAPABILITY_BROKER_URL in environment.env to the broker URL.
